summary: Rectangular flat grid plate, 40 x 24 mm and 2.5 mm thick, with a 3 x 5 grid of 4 mm through holes on an 8 mm pitch. The holes are inset 4 mm from each edge.

mountingSurfaces.description: Top flat face, with the 3 x 5 hole grid on an 8 mm pitch
Bottom flat face, with the same hole grid

notes: The drawing prints the 40 mm length, 24 mm width, 2.5 mm thickness, 4 mm hole diameter, 8 mm hole pitch, 32 mm span across the 5 columns and 16 mm span across the 3 rows. Hole positions assume the part is centered at the origin. The 4 mm edge inset follows from (40-32)/2 and (24-16)/2. The render shows the holes passing through the plate. Plate corners appear square, with no visible fillets.
